title: WSDG: update APIs in dissector creation
description:
Update Chapter 9 (Packet Dissection).

Replace deprecated APIs (`create_dissector_handle()`, `tvb_get_ptr()`,
etc) with recommended functions
(`register_dissector_with_description()`, `tvb_memdup()`, etc).

Add formal section headers to emphasize the distinction between
header boilerplate, registration, handoff, and actual dissection.

Clarify some word choices. Fix some typos and other stale information.

+We haven't registered a dissector yet. We do that next with

+for the protocol.
+If you're writing dissectors for a more complex protocol,

+carried over UDP than when it's carried over TCP, then you might choose

commits_data.message:
WSDG: update APIs in dissector creation

Update Chapter 9 (Packet Dissection).

Replace deprecated APIs (`create_dissector_handle()`, `tvb_get_ptr()`,
etc) with recommended functions
(`register_dissector_with_description()`, `tvb_memdup()`, etc).

Add formal section headers to emphasize the distinction between
header boilerplate, registration, handoff, and actual dissection.

Clarify some word choices. Fix some typos and other stale information.
